title: Blog articles + email sequence for a fitness studio

messages.content: Cardholder statement forwarded by issuing bank: The content we paid for was incomplete and low quality. The writer stopped responding. We want our money back.

transaction_info.transaction_subject: Brightline Fitness - 5 blog articles + 1 welcome email sequence (paid upfront)

sections.heading: Deliverables
sections.text: Five SEO blog articles of 1,200-1,500 words each, and one 4-email welcome sequence.

sections.heading: Pricing
sections.text: $250 per article (5 x $250 = $1,250) and $250 for the email sequence. Total $1,500, paid upfront.

sections.heading: Schedule
sections.text: One article per week starting Aug 12, email sequence by Aug 30. Last article due Sep 9.

sections.heading: Revisions
sections.text: One round of revisions per piece, requested within 7 days of delivery.

sections.heading: Article 1
sections.text: 2026-08-12 - "7 Mistakes New Lifters Make" (1,380 words) uploaded. Marked approved by nadia@brightlinefit.com on Aug 13.

sections.heading: Article 2
sections.text: 2026-08-19 - "Recovery Days Are Training Days" (1,450 words) uploaded. Approved Aug 19.

sections.heading: Article 3
sections.text: 2026-08-26 - "How to Pick a Gym You'll Actually Go To" (1,290 words) uploaded. One revision requested Aug 27, revised version approved Aug 29.

sections.heading: Email sequence
sections.text: 2026-08-30 - "Welcome to Brightline" 4-email sequence uploaded. Approved Sep 1.

sections.heading: Article 4
sections.text: 2026-09-02 - "Strength Training After 40" (1,410 words) uploaded. Approved Sep 3.

sections.heading: Article 5
sections.text: No file uploaded for Article 5 as of 2026-10-10.

documents.title: Email thread: Jordan <-> Nadia
documents.summary: Feedback on pieces and follow-ups about the last article.

sections.heading: Aug 19 - Nadia to Jordan
sections.text: The recovery article is the best thing on our blog. Our members are sharing it.

sections.heading: Sep 8 - Jordan to Nadia
sections.text: Quick heads up, I'm under the weather this week. Article 5 will be with you by Friday the 12th.

sections.heading: Sep 16 - Nadia to Jordan
sections.text: Hi Jordan, checking in on the last article? We had it on our content calendar for this week.

sections.heading: Sep 24 - Nadia to Jordan
sections.text: Jordan, it's been two weeks with no reply. Please let me know if you're still able to finish this.

documents.title: brightlinefit.com/blog (public pages, captured Oct 10)

sections.heading: Published articles
sections.text: Published on brightlinefit.com/blog: "7 Mistakes New Lifters Make" (Aug 15), "Recovery Days Are Training Days" (Aug 22), "How to Pick a Gym You'll Actually Go To" (Aug 31), "Strength Training After 40" (Sep 5). The text matches the delivered files.

sections.heading: Email signup
sections.text: The site's newsletter signup sends the "Welcome to Brightline" sequence. Captured Oct 10.

answer_key.note: Used only by scripts/eval.js to score the agent. Never sent to the model.
answer_key.real_complaint: Article 5 was never delivered and the freelancer went silent. The client feels ghosted. The 'low quality' claim is not supported: the client approved and published the other four articles and the email sequence.
